name: Rose or Lose
source:
Sawaki summoned an angel Rose and a devil Lose by chance. They are about to destroy the world, but agree to set a condition that the world could be saved if Sawaki found a lifetime partner in the remaining 5 months. The world's fate is in your hands!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
泽崎偶然召唤出了天使罗丝和恶魔洛丝。两人正准备毁灭世界，却同意设下一个条件：只要泽崎在剩下的5个月里找到终身伴侣，世界就能得救。世界的命运掌握在你手中！

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
